output.summary: Turnover rise is real, not a PeopleCore artifact: payroll-reconciled counts (115 to 193 separations) and monthly voluntary exits both show it. It exceeds the in-state peer median rise (33% to 38%). Voluntary exits stepped up in March 2026, when the firm-wide two-Saturday policy took effect, before ShiftWise went live on 2026-04-13. Monthly exits were flat afterward. Pay, manager and ShiftWise effects are not yet separated, because there is no branch-level or ShiftWise-versus-non-ShiftWise data and no pay benchmark. The manager-of-record field is stale for the seven branches that changed managers, so tying bonuses to it would punish the wrong people. A 15% raise is premature. Collect the branch-level data and the pay benchmark first. Note: I read 8 evidence files, over the 6-item limit.
